description: Natural Earth 1:110m background land silhouettes. Supported Asian countries and Russia use the atlas’s existing detailed context instead. China’s other land neighbours are drawn above them at the precision of China’s outline, in a band along it (china-neighbours.bin, world-land.mjs). No administrative boundaries or click targets.
license: Natural Earth: public domain; water-clipped Peru/Bolivia geometry: © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0

titicacaShoreline.detail: Coarse copy for the world fallback only; country fills retain full mapped shoreline

pakistanWater.method: Mangla and Tarbela reservoir holes are retained in the coarse background, as in the country land fills.

kyrgyzstanWater.license: Natural Earth public domain; © OpenStreetMap contributors ODbL1.0
kyrgyzstanWater.method: Issyk-Kul, Song-Kul, Chatyr-Kul and Toktogul Reservoir are cut out of fallback land as well as the detailed map.

myanmarLaosWater.license: Natural Earth public domain; © OpenStreetMap contributors ODbL 1.0
myanmarLaosWater.method: Lake water excluded from detailed country land is also cut from fallback world land.

norwegianAntarcticCoast.method: The coarse Antarctic land in the displayed Queen Maud Land sector is replaced by a lightweight preview of the Natural Earth 1:10m coastline used in the explicitly labelled Norwegian claim. Its country palette follows the Norwegian context, keeping coarse land out of the water.

himalayaCountryShapes.method: Coarse fallback is omitted for these three supported countries; their existing detailed portal sources provide reconciled land and mapped Kaptai Lake holes. Avoids duplicate land, shoreline protrusions and extra world-background download weight.
